one_line: Eastern Indian king of Kamarupa and key ally of Harsha in the anti-Gauda diplomacy of the early 7th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean but athletic build, medium-tall and slightly willowy rather than bulky.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, warm medium-brown complexion, sharp brows, and a calm, observant gaze; default expression is a composed, diplomatic half-smile that hints at calculation.
appearance.hair: Long straight black hair parted in the middle, drawn back into a high, smooth topknot at the crown bound with a thin gold band, the rest falling to mid-back; a plain narrow golden circlet with a small central leaf-shaped front ornament sits just above the brow.
appearance.costume: He wears a long-sleeved, calf-length white cotton tunic (angarkha-style) overlapping left over right and tied with an inner tie, over which a rich saffron-yellow silk uttariya (shawl) is draped diagonally from the left shoulder under the right arm and back around, its border woven with a thin maroon and gold geometric pattern; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped off-white cotton dhoti reaching the ankles with a broad maroon border, pleated neatly at the front; he has a simple fitted dark red cloth kamarband (waist sash) holding a small pouch, a pair of modest gold stud earrings, a single flat gold pendant on a thin chain, and several slim gold bangles on his right wrist; footwear is brown leather sandals with toe loops and a strap around the ankle, appropriate to early medieval eastern India.
appearance.signature: A rolled bundle of pale sachi-bark manuscripts tied with a red silk cord, carried in his left hand or tucked under his arm, with a faintly visible seal-impression tag attached.

ref_desc: Bhaskaravarman is a lean, medium-brown young king with an oval face, long black hair in a high topknot under a simple gold circlet, wearing a white tunic, saffron-yellow silk uttariya, off-white dhoti with maroon borders, gold ornaments, brown sandals, and carrying a red-tied sachi-bark manuscript bundle.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Bhaskaravarman of Kamarupa: a lean, medium-tall young king with a warm medium-brown complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, sharp brows and a composed diplomatic half-smile, his long straight black hair parted in the middle and gathered into a smooth high topknot at the crown bound with a thin gold band, with the rest falling to mid-back, and a plain narrow golden circlet crowned by a small leaf-shaped ornament above his brow; dress him in an era-accurate early 7th-century eastern Indian royal outfit consisting of a long-sleeved, calf-length white cotton overlapping tunic, a rich saffron-yellow silk uttariya shawl draped diagonally from the left shoulder under the right arm and back around with a maroon and gold geometric border, and a tightly wrapped off-white cotton dhoti with a broad maroon border pleated neatly at the front, secured with a fitted dark red cloth kamarband sash that holds a small pouch; add modest gold stud earrings, a single flat gold pendant on a thin chain, and several slim gold bangles on his right wrist, along with simple brown leather sandals with toe loops and ankle straps; his signature prop is a rolled bundle of pale sachi-bark manuscripts tied with a red silk cord and a small seal tag, carried in his left hand or tucked under his arm; use a palette dominated by saffron yellow, maroon, white, gold and brown, and show him from multiple angles to emphasise consistent face, topknot and circlet, draped garments, and the manuscript bundle.
